# hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code  ·  ⭐50490  ·  watch  ·  stable
https://github.com/hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code · pushed 2026-07-20 · triaged 2026-07-20 · seen on github

**What it is:** A large, actively-maintained "awesome list" of Claude Code resources — skills, agents, statuslines, plugins, developer tooling — with an auto-generated "recently added" ticker.
**Reusable for us:** Not an asset itself, but a high-signal meta-source: a good place to periodically skim for candidates our own crawl (`scripts/discover.sh`) might miss, since it's hand-curated rather than star/points-ranked.
**Token / effectiveness angle:** n/a directly.
**How to adopt:** watch — consider an occasional manual skim of this list's "Recently Added" section as a supplementary discovery input, distinct from the automated crawl sources.
